verdict.rationale: Raygun documents SDK-level filtering that strips sensitive data such as credit card details before errors are sent (raygun-docs-12, raygun-docs-24). Server-side control is limited to a single application-settings toggle that disables IP address storage (raygun-docs-13), with no evidence of configurable server-side scrubbing rules. missing for 10: configurable server-side PII scrubbing rules beyond the IP toggle, detailed SDK filter configuration docs (field/key patterns per SDK), independent or hands-on corroboration.
